package.name: aws_sdk_vendor
package.description: Vendor package for the AWS SDK for C++ (core + s3 only), built from a pinned source tag at colcon-build time — the object-storage client the Bridge's Uploader uses (ADR-0005, ADR-0007). Only `s3` is built (`-DBUILD_ONLY=s3`); zlib request compression is disabled (optional per the SDK), keeping the build minimal. Verified working against RustFS (PutObject + multipart) before adoption.
